capabilities: render timelines, family trees and realm trees from note properties
draw and edit fantasy or real-world maps with territories, routes and borders
define fictional calendars with moons, seasons and holidays
build dashboards combining world views and embed them in notes
check, tidy and export world data including GEDCOM and websites
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; installs via BRAT or manually. The author states it was written entirely by AI (Claude) and has not been reviewed line by line by a human developer; the README advises backing up the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn note properties into world visualisations such as timelines, genealogy charts, territory maps or fictional calendars for worldbuilding and campaigns.

relations.evidence: Folder notes by Lost Paul (obsidian-folder-notes): the folder note itself (Folder/Folder.md), opening it by clicking
Iconic by Holo (obsidian-iconic): icons on notes in the file explorer and search, and an icon picker

summary: Worldbuilding toolkit that renders notes as timelines, family trees, realm trees, maps with territories, connections graphs, and fictional calendars.
